name: zt-term-cards-fixture
description: The provider-contract fixture of the Term-card branch (S20, #164): one stage that schedules the compiler's writer, reviewer and fix jobs on the shared DSMP pool. The stand-in runtime of ../tests/term-cards-harness.mjs answers the compiler commands and the DeepSeek managers; no model, provider, zt or archive call runs. The real stage graph belongs to S24 (#167).
whenToUse: Not run by itself: tests/term-cards-harness.mjs builds it to check manager roles, wave size, continuation, deletion and workspace cleanup

preflight.P1: Goal: prove the Term-card managed contract (design 12.4, S20 / #164) before the stage graph of S24 (#167) exists.
preflight.P2: Inputs: out and citationKey only. The harness passes a temporary staging folder and replaces every compiler command and manager with a stand-in.
preflight.P3: Units of work: none. The fixture writes no ledger unit; the module returns the branch report.
preflight.P4: Roles: manager = Haiku, effort low (the DSMP manager); relay = Haiku low, the zt-relay agent type (the compiler commands).
preflight.P5: Stage graph: one stage. The pool case adds ten identical stages so the shared dsmpSlot pool's eight-manager cap is observable.
preflight.P6: Modules: zt-term-cards (the branch driver) and the shared zt-workflow-lib plus the installed DSMP block.
preflight.P7: Checks: the harness checks that only the shared pool is used, that a manager holds at most eight conversations, that writers are retained only through their wave, and that every conversation is deleted and the workspace registration removed while the staging files stay.
preflight.P8: Failure policy: a failed writer job, a failed manager and a failed deletion each leave the branch report failed; the wave's conversations are still settled and the workspace registration is still removed. A deletion the provider refuses stays registered for the run cleanup.
preflight.P9: Dry run: term-cards-harness.mjs runs one book, a ten-branch pool case and a failed-job case against the stand-in runtime.

manager.description: Haiku: runs the DeepSeek job managers (writer, reviewer, fix, settle waves); it writes no Card

relay.description: Haiku as the zt-relay agent type: runs one compiler command and returns its last line

stages.title: Term cards
stages.detail: wave writers, review the mathematical drafts, one fix, delete the wave, clean the workspace registration
